tamevātmānaṃ niṣkṛṣya karatalāmalakavaddarśayanta ivānye prāhuḥ -
draṣṭṛdarśaneti

darśanāccakṣuṣamānasādivṛtteḥ prathamaṃ pūrvameva tadutpattisākṣitayā
bhāsamānamityanena pūrvasiddhastripuṭīsākṣī sarvānubhavasiddho vivicya
darśitaḥ
yena sarvaṃ yaddhi sarvaṃ tatsatyaṃ samupāsmahe
badhnāti bhāvanāṃ bhūyo naro nāsau sa gardabhaḥ

praśamitamanasaḥ svake svarūpe
bhavati sukhe sthitiruttamā cirāya
